purpose: Fresh 32B language-LoRA GRPO, learning rate 1e-5, seed 42, 400 optimizer steps; final checkpoint evaluated on the fixed validation64 cohort.
reward: R_fmt + binary foreground IoU against full instance masks; no count, separation or topology reward.

optimizer_evidence.adapter_changed_steps_definition: Count of steps whose adapter differs from its initial weights; not a comparison against the preceding step.

resources.training_elapsed_definition: Training-loop elapsed, including periodic evaluations and checkpoint work; not the sum of optimizer-step durations.

data.selection: Official-30 MoNuSeg training sources, patient-disjoint train/validation partition; selected native 128x128 crops with 1-8 annotated nuclei. This run evaluates all 64 validation crops; benchmark8 is not pooled into a separate metric.
data.gt_count_unit: Crop-level GT instances/occurrences. A source nucleus crossing a crop border can occur in more than one crop; all such occurrences remain within one patient/split. Existing crop metrics retain total_gt_count=384, not 340.

example_selection_rule: Lexicographically first ID with GT count exactly 1 and first with GT count >1; no output-based selection

evidence.raw_answers: before_records.jsonl and after_records.jsonl preserve all source completion records byte-for-byte.

conclusion: Final-checkpoint macro PQ rose from 0.0141416 to 0.0168700 and matched GT occurrences from 7 to 10 of 384. Count MAE and coordinate-contract validity worsened slightly, while foreground IoU decreased. Most nuclei remain unmatched. The 400-step 32B budget differs from the 1,000-step 7B budget, so this is not a causal model-size comparison.
limitations: The same 64 selected validation crops from four patients are reused for monitoring and setting selection, not an untouched final test.
This report uses the final 400-step checkpoint, not the best intermediate checkpoint. Three periodic evaluations occurred during training.
Only 10 of 384 crop-level GT occurrences match and 18 of 64 final answers fail the coordinate contract; reliable detection remains unresolved.
The 32B run used 400 steps versus 1,000 for the 7B runs. Model identity and optimization budget both differ; no causal model-size claim.
One seed, no pooling with benchmark8. Full-mask reward engineering; no weak-label, SOTA or clinical claim.
The 384 within-crop GT occurrences represent 340 unique source nuclei; boundary fragments can repeat across neighboring crops in the same split. Crop-level metrics retain denominator 384.
invalid_answer_handling: All 17 before and 18 after rejected responses contain at least one box outside the declared 224x224 prompt frame. Their JSON decodes, but the coordinate contract fails and the strict parser rejects the entire response. Empty final masks remain in all metric denominators; exact emitted text is retained.

coordinate_rejection_audit.method: Independently JSON-decode every rejected answer block and check every raw box against each record prompt_size; do not repair or clip coordinates.

budget_context.interpretation: The 7B and 32B checkpoints and completed optimization budgets differ. Scores on the common validation cohort are descriptive; no causal effect of model size or robust preferred architecture is established.
